claims.text: The span detector is part of an extended Stochastic Answer Network (SAN) that includes a binary classifier for unanswerable questions.
The architecture consists of a shared lower layer for both the span detector and the binary classifier, with separate top layers for each task.
The span detector employs a multi-turn answer module to enhance its performance.
